detail: Phase shop completed: only listed assertions passed. Other UAT cases remain Not Run.

checkpoints.name: identity
checkpoints.description: Expected account authenticated, onboarding complete, real public UID verified

checkpoints.name: shop-catalog
checkpoints.description: Shop loads real catalog and displays current coin balance

checkpoints.name: shop-insufficient-coins
checkpoints.description: Insufficient coins rejected; balance, purchase history and ownership unchanged

checkpoints.name: shop-product
checkpoints.description: Selected product shows actual price and product preview

checkpoints.name: shop-try-on
checkpoints.description: Trying on unowned item changes preview only; saved equipment and ownership unchanged

checkpoints.name: shop-purchased
checkpoints.description: Selected item ownership granted and exact price deducted (partial UAT-07-002)

checkpoints.name: avatar-draft
checkpoints.description: Owned purchased item selected; equipment is not persisted before Save

checkpoints.name: shop-equipped
checkpoints.description: Purchased item is saved in the matching avatar slot (partial UAT-07-008)

checkpoints.name: avatar-home
checkpoints.description: Home reloads saved purchased outfit after returning from wardrobe

checkpoints.name: avatar-reopened
checkpoints.description: Reopened wardrobe retains saved equipment; exactly one purchase and no further coin deduction

scope: Guided phase shop. Human operates real UI (including OTP); automatic API/state assertions and screenshots. Only checkpoint assertions are checked. Negative cases and other parts of the 88-case plan remain Not Run. No account deletion.
